motion.name: ease-stage

motion.purpose: Day/night swap on body, logo masks, and toggle track.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action — header Contactar, hero archive link.

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: Cut-corner day/night switch with a sliding accent knob; persists to localStorage.
components.css: .ds-toggle{border:0;background:none;padding:0;cursor:pointer;line-height:0} .ds-toggle-track{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;width:3.9rem;height:2.2rem;padding:0 .5rem;border:1px solid var(--border,rgba(125,211,252,.14));background:var(--bg-elevated,#0a1220);clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 8px) 0,100% 8px,100% 100%,8px 100%,0 calc(100% - 8px));transition:border-color .25s ease,background .35s ease} .ds-toggle:hover .ds-toggle-track{border-color:var(--accent,#38bdf8)} .ds-toggle:focus-visible .ds-toggle-track{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#38bdf8);outline-offset:3px} .ds-ico{position:relative;z-index:2} .ds-ico-sun{color:var(--text-dim,#8ea3bd);opacity:.5} .ds-ico-moon{color:var(--on-accent,#04121f)} .ds-knob{position:absolute;top:50%;left:.22rem;width:1.6rem;height:1.6rem;margin-top:-.8rem;background:var(--accent,#38bdf8);clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 6px) 0,100% 6px,100% 100%,6px 100%,0 calc(100% - 6px));transform:translateX(1.68rem);transition:transform .32s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow .3s ease} .ds-toggle:hover .ds-knob{box-shadow:0 0 0 5px var(--accent-glow,rgba(56,189,248,.22))}

components.name: Filter Pill
components.description: Category filter above the archive; active state fills accent.
components.css: .ds-filter{font-family:Archivo,sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem;background:transparent;color:var(--text-dim,#8ea3bd);border:1px solid var(--border-strong,rgba(125,211,252,.32));padding:.55rem 1rem;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;gap:.45rem;align-items:center;clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 8px) 0,100% 8px,100% 100%,8px 100%,0 calc(100% - 8px));transition:border-color .2s ease,color .2s ease,background .2s ease} .ds-filter span{opacity:.7;font-weight:500} .ds-filter:hover{color:var(--text,#eaf2fb)} .ds-filter.is-active{background:var(--accent,#38bdf8);color:var(--on-accent,#04121f);border-color:var(--accent,#38bdf8)}

components.name: Live Pill
components.description: Availability badge in the hero and closing CTA.
components.css: .ds-pill-live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;font-family:Archivo,sans-serif;font-size:.76rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-dim,#8ea3bd);border:1px solid var(--border-strong,rgba(125,211,252,.32));padding:.42rem .85rem .42rem .65rem;clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 8px) 0,100% 8px,100% 100%,8px 100%,0 calc(100% - 8px))} .ds-dot{width:.5rem;height:.5rem;border-radius:50%;background:var(--live,#ff5a5a);animation:ds-pulse 1.9s infinite} @keyframes ds-pulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(25, 207, 61,0.55)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px transparent}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 transparent}}

components.name: Stat Band
components.description: Hierarchical stat display — one lead figure plus hairline-separated secondary counts. Replaces an earlier four-equal-box grid.
components.html:
1000+Proyectos realizados

components.css: .ds-statband{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(1.25rem,4vw,3rem);width:100%;padding-top:2rem;border-top:1px solid var(--border,rgba(125,211,252,.14))} .ds-stat-lead{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.15rem} .ds-stat-num{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(3.2rem,8vw,4.6rem);line-height:.9;color:var(--accent,#38bdf8)} .ds-stat-label{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-dim,#8ea3bd)} .ds-stat-rest{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none} .ds-stat-rest li{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.1rem;padding:0 clamp(.9rem,3vw,1.6rem);border-left:1px solid var(--border,rgba(125,211,252,.14))} .ds-stat-rest li:first-child{border-left:0} .ds-stat-rest .n{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:1.75rem;line-height:1;color:var(--text,#eaf2fb)} .ds-stat-rest .l{font-size:.66rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-dim,#8ea3bd);text-align:center}

components.name: Archive Card
components.description: Masonry gallery tile with cut corner, viewfinder brackets, and a sliding caption.
components.css: .ds-card{position:relative;border:1px solid var(--border,rgba(125,211,252,.14));background:var(--panel,#0c1424);overflow:hidden;clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 14px) 0,100% 14px,100% 100%,14px 100%,0 calc(100% - 14px));transition:border-color .25s ease,transform .35s ease} .ds-card:hover{border-color:var(--border-strong,rgba(125,211,252,.32));transform:translateY(-3px)} .ds-card img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto} .ds-corner{position:absolute;width:1.1rem;height:1.1rem;border-color:var(--accent,#38bdf8);opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s ease} .ds-tl{top:.5rem;left:.5rem;border-top:2px solid;border-left:2px solid} .ds-tr{top:.5rem;right:.5rem;border-top:2px solid;border-right:2px solid} .ds-bl{bottom:.5rem;left:.5rem;border-bottom:2px solid;border-left:2px solid} .ds-br{bottom:.5rem;right:.5rem;border-bottom:2px solid;border-right:2px solid} .ds-card:hover .ds-corner{opacity:1} .ds-card figcaption{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;padding:.75rem .9rem;background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(3,8,16,.94),rgba(3,8,16,0));transform:translateY(15%);opacity:0;transition:transform .25s ease,opacity .25s ease} .ds-card:hover figcaption{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1} .ds-tag{font-size:.64rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--on-accent,#04121f);background:var(--accent,#38bdf8);padding:.2rem .42rem} .ds-title{font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;color:#f4f9ff}

components.name: Carousel Slide
components.description: Three-up showcase stage; side slides are rotated, scaled, blurred and dimmed rather than shadowed.
components.css: .ds-stage{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/7.4;overflow:hidden} .ds-slide{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:64%;margin:0;aspect-ratio:16/9;overflow:hidden;background:var(--panel,#0c1424);border:1px solid var(--border,rgba(125,211,252,.14));opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.8);clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 18px) 0,100% 18px,100% 100%,18px 100%,0 calc(100% - 18px));transition:transform .75s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),opacity .6s ease,filter .6s ease} .ds-slide img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover} .ds-slide.is-current{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1);border-color:var(--border-strong,rgba(125,211,252,.32));z-index:3} .ds-slide.is-prev,.ds-slide.is-next{opacity:.45;filter:blur(2px) saturate(.7);z-index:2} .ds-slide.is-prev{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) translateX(-64%) rotate(-6deg) scale(.78)} .ds-slide.is-next{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) translateX(64%) rotate(6deg) scale(.78)}

narrative.overview:
FranVisuals designs the graphics that run underneath live streams, match broadcasts, and trading calls. The site is built out of the brand's own logo — an angular navy chevron sliced by a lightning bolt — rather than out of generic landing-page furniture. Every container in the system repeats the logo's cut corner: a notch taken out of the top-right and bottom-left of buttons, pills, cards, and the theme toggle. Nothing is rounded, because nothing in the logo is rounded.

The system ships in two themes of equal standing. Night is a near-black navy control room where a bright celeste is the only lit color. Day is the near-white sheet from FranVisuals' own brand banners, where the logo returns to its navy and the accent deepens so it keeps its contrast against paper. The theme is not a preference toggle bolted on — the brand kit itself exists in both, so the site does too.

Type is a two-voice pairing: Bebas Neue for anything shouted and Archivo for anything read or clicked. This is a Persuade surface: prove range and volume fast through the work itself, then hand the visitor a one-tap WhatsApp line.
keyCharacteristics: Dual navy/near-white theming with a single celeste accent that re-tunes per theme
The logo's cut corner as the universal container shape; zero border-radius
Condensed broadcast caps over a grotesk workhorse
The logo itself as a recolorable CSS mask — one asset, both themes
Flat, hairline-bordered depth; no shadows anywhere

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The celeste is reserved for things that are live, actionable, or numeric — a button, an active state, a count, a framing bracket. It never colors a paragraph or fills a full-bleed region.

rules.name: The Two-Value Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent has exactly one night value and one day value. A new state borrows one of them or stays neutral; it never introduces a third blue.

rules.name: The Caption Ink Exception
rules.body: Text sitting on a photograph is theme-independent, because the image underneath is the same in both themes.

rules.name: The Shout/Talk Rule
rules.body: Bebas Neue shouts (headlines, stat figures, wordmark, ticker); Archivo talks (everything else). A single string never mixes both faces.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. Interactive surfaces signal state through border brightening, a 2-3px lift, or the corner brackets appearing — never through elevation.

dos: Do keep the accent rare — buttons, active states, figures, brackets, ticker bullets — per the One Voice Rule.
Do apply the cut corner to every new container, sized to the component (6-18px).
Do render the logo through the CSS mask so it inherits the theme instead of shipping two image files.
Do keep both themes at WCAG AA or better; the day accent is deepened specifically to hold contrast on paper.
Do let the archive's aspect ratios stay mixed; never force-crop a 9:16 piece into a 16:9 tile.
Do gate the ticker, the carousel autoplay, and the live-dot pulse behind prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add a drop-shadow or scale a card up on hover — depth comes from borders, layering, and the carousel's own transform language.
Don't introduce a third accent value or a second hue; the accent has exactly one night and one day value.
Don't round any corner, anywhere, for any component.
Don't let a marquee group be narrower than the viewport — that is what makes the loop cut.
Don't leave off-stage carousel slides focusable; they must stay inert.
